datasets.name: RDD2022 · multi-national road damage
datasets.role: training and held-out test for the road-damage detector
datasets.origin: Arya et al., RDD2022: A multi-national image dataset for automatic Road Damage Detection (2022), CRDDC'2022
datasets.content: Vehicle-mounted smartphone and dashcam images: Japan, India, Czech Republic, Norway, United States, China (motorbike)
datasets.sampling: 1000 train / 120 val / 250 test images per country, seeded; sampled inside the dataset's fixed splits; China_Drone (aerial) excluded
datasets.labels: 4 classes: longitudinal crack (D00), transverse crack (D10), alligator crack (D20), pothole (D40); labels from the dataset

datasets.name: Tashkent street imagery · our labels
datasets.role: local test set on Uzbek roads; never used for training
datasets.origin: Mapillary contributors; faces and licence plates blurred by Mapillary
datasets.license: CC BY-SA 4.0 (images) · our annotations CC BY-SA 4.0
datasets.content: 1,449 perspective phone images captured from vehicles in Tashkent (2016-2026 captures, mostly 2019+), 0.02° grid, at most 4 frames per capture sequence
datasets.sampling: grid over the city bbox 69.15-69.40 E, 41.23-41.40 N; split train/test by grid tile so no street appears in both
datasets.labels: test split: image-level labels (damage present, damage types, not-road, uncertain) on 120 images, first pass by Claude (LLM vision, our AI assistant) without model pre-labels, to be verified by the team in the platform's review screen. Images from the other tiles are kept for future local fine-tuning and are not used yet

datasets.name: V2X-Sim 2.0 mini · cooperative driving
datasets.role: cooperative-perception benchmark and the bundled demo scene
datasets.origin: Li et al., V2X-Sim: Multi-Agent Collaborative Perception Dataset and Benchmark for Autonomous Driving, IEEE RA-L 2022 (CARLA + SUMO)
datasets.content: One Town03 intersection, 100 frames at 5 Hz: road-side unit with 4 cameras at 7 m, 5 vehicles with 6 cameras each, RGB + semantic segmentation + depth, 3D boxes
datasets.sampling: all frames; ego vehicles 1, 2, 4 (vehicle 3 leaves the area, vehicle 5 is on an overpass)
datasets.labels: 3D boxes from the dataset; per-camera occlusion labels generated by us from segmentation + depth (not part of the dataset)

datasets.name: Tashkent crossing · dashcam case
datasets.role: real-world case for CrossGuard: reconstruction of a crash and the counterfactual with a crossing camera
datasets.source: dashcam footage recorded and provided by the SwarmSight team
datasets.origin: one dashcam, Tashkent, 16 July 2026, 18:27:53-18:28:29 local time; GPS and speed burned into the video
datasets.license: provided by the team for this project; only anonymised frames are redistributed
datasets.content: 79 frames (20.0-29.75 s at 8 frames/s, 960x540); the replay stops at the moment of impact
datasets.sampling: the 10 s before impact; the original clip is not in the repository
datasets.labels: telemetry read by us from the overlay (once a second); the motorcycle annotated by us in 5 frames (the detector misses it); faces and plate bands blurred by us using detections from each frame and its 4 neighbours

datasets.name: OpenStreetMap
datasets.role: map background; plan of the crossing used to fix the dashcam's scale and the cross street's direction
datasets.license: ODbL 1.0 (data), tiles CC BY-SA 2.0, © OpenStreetMap contributors
datasets.content: map tiles shown in the browser

datasets.name: COCO-pretrained YOLO11n weights
datasets.role: road-user detector (person, bicycle, car, motorcycle, bus, truck) and starting point for our road-damage model
datasets.origin: Ultralytics YOLO11, trained on MS COCO
datasets.license: AGPL-3.0 (weights and Ultralytics code; this repository is AGPL-3.0 accordingly)
datasets.content: pretrained weights, exported by us to ONNX

no_personal_data: No customer records, no non-public data. Street imagery comes from public, licensed sources that blur faces and plates; evidence snapshots are additionally blurred by us before storage.
